title: Multi-Week Ceramics Class
source_quote:
Multi-Week Ceramics Class

Best for: Beginners to Advanced Beginners who want structure and guidance.
evidence_sentence: The class description mentions access to cone 10 clay bodies and reduction gas firings alongside electric kilns.
evidence_quote: We're also excited to offer cone 10 clay bodies, reduction gas firings, and a growing selection of cone 10 glazes, giving artists the opportunity to explore both oxidation and reduction firing techniques.
summary: Weekly ceramics class for beginners to advanced beginners with access to both electric and gas reduction firing.
